verdict.rationale: LegalOS is a web-based immigration-filing SaaS that collects user data through intake flows, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers visa services, attorney review, fees and disclaimers, but nothing documents a telemetry or analytics opt-out, a privacy setting, or a cookie-consent control. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
